toAdvanced.title: Turn on advanced mode?
toAdvanced.text: Advanced mode unlocks additional instructions and training with websites and videos. Poorly written instructions can make the service worse: use the form whenever possible.

toSimple.title: Go back to simple mode?
toSimple.text: When you publish, the additional instructions and the website and video trainings will be removed.

toTakeOver.title: Take control of the text?
toTakeOver.text: You will edit the agent's text freely. The agent stops receiving the function's improvements until you go back to the form.
toTakeOver.textAdvanced: You will edit the agent's text freely. The agent stops receiving the function's improvements until you go back to the form. Website and video trainings belong to advanced mode and are removed when you publish.

toForm.title: Go back to the form?
toForm.text: Edits made to the agent's text will be lost. The text is built from the form again, using the latest version of the function. In advanced mode you can add instructions and train with websites and videos.

additional.label: Additional instructions
additional.hint: They are added at the end of the agent's text. {count}/{max} characters.

attention.title: {count, plural, one {# attention point} other {# attention points}}
attention.description: Warnings do not block publishing, but the agent performs better with them resolved.
attention.body: Fields with warnings are highlighted in the form. You can fix them first or go on to the preview.

preview.title: Publication preview
preview.versionChange: The function goes from version {from} to {to}.
preview.default: Check what changes in the agent.

errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some fields are invalid. Review them and try again.
errors.AGENT_OUT_OF_SYNC: The agent was not found in GPTMaker; contact support.
errors.AGENT_BUSY: The agent is being changed; wait and try again.
errors.FUNCTION_NOT_CONFIGURED: This agent has no function configured.
errors.FUNCTION_COMPILE_FAILED: Could not build the agent with these answers.
errors.FUNCTION_PUBLICATION_PENDING: A publication is in progress; wait for it to finish.
errors.FUNCTION_NOTHING_TO_RETRY: There is no failed publication to retry.
errors.FUNCTION_TAKE_OVER_NOT_ALLOWED: Only partners can take control of the behavior.
errors.FUNCTION_TRANSFER_AGENT_INVALID: Choose another agent for the transfer.
errors.PLAN_TRAINING_LIMIT: You have reached your plan's training limit. Remove knowledge base items or change plans.
errors.GPTMAKER_REJECTED: GPTMaker rejected the agent data; nothing was changed. Review the fields.
errors.GPTMAKER_UNAVAILABLE: Could not complete the change in GPTMaker right now; nothing was changed. Try again shortly.
